environment.viewport: 390x844 for the instrument; 320/390/768/1440 for the reflow matrix

honestLimits: Headless Chromium in the en locale; no real screen reader and no real user.
The pilot pages are synthetic pairs built for this comparison, not field pages.
Long-task timings come from the browser performance timeline, not field INP.
No claim here compares SUS output with any other method; the host pilots stay not-run.

pilots.guide: Modern Web Guidance — responsive table / record layout (pinned modern-web-guidance v1.0.0)
pilots.claim: Stacking table rows at narrow widths without dropping the header row keeps the header-to-cell association, at no reflow cost.
pilots.instrument: Playwright ariaSnapshot() columnheader count at 390px; document scrollWidth vs clientWidth; axe wcag2a/aa serious+critical; runHardeningMatrix 3 viewports x 2 themes x 2 motion settings

negativeCase.description: After page with the header row forced to display:none — the instrument must lose the association.

fallbackCase.description: After page at 320px, the narrowest audited width — the association and the overflow-free layout must both survive.

pilots.guide: Modern Web Guidance — navigation drawer (pinned modern-web-guidance v1.0.0)
pilots.claim: A drawer that exposes its expanded state, dismisses on Escape, moves focus in and back, and leaves the background inert is measurable; a class-toggle drawer is not.
pilots.instrument: Playwright keyboard drive: aria-expanded before and after opening, document.activeElement containment over 6 Tab steps, Escape dismissal, focus return to the trigger, plus a javaScriptEnabled:false context for the no-JS fallback

negativeCase.description: The class-toggle drawer — the same markup without the contract. The instrument must report the missing state.

fallbackCase.description: After page with JavaScript disabled — the four section links must stay visible and reachable.

pilots.guide: Modern Web Guidance — identify INP causes / yielding on long tasks (pinned modern-web-guidance v1.0.0)
pilots.claim: The same 360 ms work budget split into 20 ms chunks with a yield between them produces no long task, so input is not blocked for the whole handler duration.
pilots.instrument: PerformanceObserver longtask entries around one scripted click, three runs per page with the median reported; totalBlockingMs = sum(max(0, duration - 50)); lab long-task time, not field INP

negativeCase.description: One synchronous handler for the whole work budget — the instrument must see the long task.

fallbackCase.description: After page with window.scheduler removed — the timeout fallback must still avoid the long task.
